messages:
Kyoko Tan: Hey team! Kyoko here — first day in DevEx (remote, PST). Quick questions: who handles laptop shipping/MDM, how do I get VPN + GitHub org access, and where's the intro onboarding checklist? Also: tiny fun fact — I collect vending-machine coffee stickers from each country I've visited :coffee: 

Maya Li: Welcome Kyoko!! :tada: I'm your onboarding buddy — Priya and I will help. TL;DR: Alex (IT) for hardware/MDM, Sam for infra/GitHub, and DevOps Bot tracks checklist. What's your preferred time for a 30m intro today?

Kyoko Tan: Thanks Maya! I can do 10am PT. My personal email is kyoko.personal@example.com (that's where I got the offer).

Alex (IT): Hey Kyoko — welcome! I've sent the MDM invite to kyoko.personal@example.com. Laptop will ship today (FedEx tracking should arrive in 3-5 biz days). For SSH: generate an ed25519 key and paste the public key into the onboarding form. Command: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"kyoko@redwood.com\"``` Let me know when you've uploaded it and I'll add you to the GitHub org.

Kyoko Tan: Got it, thanks. One follow-up: do you want the public key pasted into the form or uploaded somewhere?

Alex (IT): Paste into the form is perfect. If you run into permission errors when creating the key, run `chmod 700 ~/.ssh` and `chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519`.

Sam Wells: @Kyoko Tan — welcome! I'll add you to the infra and repo teams once Alex confirms the SSH key. Also drop your preferred GitHub username here so I don't guess and give access to the wrong handle.

Kyoko Tan: GitHub handle is kyoko-tan. Thanks Sam.

Priya Rao: Hey Kyoko :wave: Happy first day! 10am PT works for me too — sending calendar invite now for a quick intro + walkthrough of our docs and common PR templates. Also FYI, we have a short "who to ask" doc in the handbook (Docs -> Onboarding -> Who to Ask).

Maya Li: I'll DM you a short checklist: Slack channels to join, MDM steps, calendar links, and recommended first-day tasks. Also: welcome snack tradition — drop a photo of your plant or coffee mug in #random when you can :blossom:

DevOps Bot: New hire added: Kyoko Tan. Onboarding checklist created (ID: OH-4219876543). Items: MDM invite, Laptop shipment, SSH key, GitHub access, Intro sync. Assigned to: Alex (IT), Sam Wells, Priya Rao.

Kyoko Tan: Awesome, thank you all. Looking forward to the 10am intro. And yes — expect a very tiny sticker photo later :grin:

Maya Li: See you at 10! :rocket:

Alex (IT): Ping me here when you've pasted the pubkey and I will confirm org invite. If shipping address needs to change, DM me ASAP.

Sam Wells: Also if you want early access to the internal dev cluster for experimentation, we'll need the signed infra access form — I'll drop it in the thread after the intro.

Kyoko Tan: Will do. Thanks everyone for the warm welcome :heart:
